scope: Verified active Chinese content in exact Godot snapshot; cue directions are prose-evidenced, with snowline wind explicitly provided by user.

legacy_dialogue.choice_semantics: Only selected branch lines play; choice-label display, hover, and other options do not trigger literal scene actions.

module_dialogue.status: implementation exists; current snapshot has no active module manifest or chapter prose
module_dialogue.choice_semantics: choice nodes return generic DIALOGUE_CHOOSE_REPLY and presentation_info choices, so text_key alone cannot identify a module choice node

forbidden_entry_points: typewriter every-character loop without per-entry cue token
translation notification when marker is unchanged
name update when marker is unchanged
presentation.deduplication: One true line-entry token per marker visit. Trigger zero or more planned cues once under that token; never replay on typewriter reflow. Revisiting same marker in a deliberate new session can start a new visit.
presentation.phrase_timing: Optional exact localized phrase anchor may schedule a once-per-line cue. Bind schedule at true entry; do not make each revealed character an audio event. Skip can reveal pending cue once; changing line cancels old pending cues.
presentation.pause: Freeze scheduled narrative cue clock while menu paused. Resume cannot retrigger entry.
presentation.save_restore: Restore scene bed from saved narrative position without replaying one-shot dog/cloth/flask unless presentation genuinely restarts that line. Reset transient audio cue state on new session; never mutate story save schema for audio.
presentation.restore_scene_resolution: Every dialogue row carries absolute environment ID (not just inherit), so restore can establish current bed directly without replaying prior cues.
presentation.cue_delay_contract: A cue with delay_seconds > 0 schedules from its once-per-line phrase threshold. Two soft_steps on one phrase use independent cue_id tokens and 0.42-second spacing. Composite footstep takes run once; do not repeat their internal step count.
presentation.environment_and_scene: environment stores catalog ambience ID for direct restore; scene stores narrative mood profile. Empty music means deliberate score silence; music.story starts on RULES_03 after RULES_02 confirmed diversion, gain -24 dB.

film.gameplay_audio: mute or stop gameplay beds and BGM from lead-in until film ends/skips
film.caption_advance: Subtitle changes are not dialogue line entries and must not dispatch added SFX
film.active_version: v7; rejected v9 is not active

OPENING_CHRONICLE_PAGE_1.text_zh:
帝国出现之前，世上没有帝国。
只有一座座自由城镇：各有各的城墙，各有各的田地，各有各的纷争，除了自己，不奉任何人为主。
OPENING_CHRONICLE_PAGE_1.text_en:
Before the Empire, there was no empire.
There were the free towns: each with its own walls, its own fields, its own quarrels, and no master but itself.
OPENING_CHRONICLE_PAGE_1.direction: Conservative environmental bed only; never add unsupported literal events from historical nouns.

OPENING_CHRONICLE_PAGE_2.text_zh:
然后，白冬来了。春天不化的雪，直到盛夏仍是一片白的田野。
它年复一年向这片土地蔓延，每一年都走得更远一点，夺走得更多一点。
OPENING_CHRONICLE_PAGE_2.text_en:
Then came the White Winter. Snow that would not melt in spring. Fields that lay white into midsummer.
And every year it crept a little further across the land, and took a little more.
OPENING_CHRONICLE_PAGE_2.direction: Conservative environmental bed only; never add unsupported literal events from historical nouns.

OPENING_CHRONICLE_PAGE_3.text_zh:
有一个人看懂了这场冬天能拿来做什么。雪落到哪里，他就带着运粮车和长矛跟到哪里。
饥饿的城镇为面包打开城门，他便把它们的名字写上自己的地图。
OPENING_CHRONICLE_PAGE_3.text_en:
One man understood what the winter was for. Wherever the snow fell, he followed it with grain wagons and spears.
Starving towns opened their gates for bread, and he wrote their names upon his map.
OPENING_CHRONICLE_PAGE_3.direction: Conservative environmental bed only; never add unsupported literal events from historical nouns.

OPENING_CHRONICLE_PAGE_4.text_zh:
一座又一座，地图被填满了。那人为自己加冕，称帝。
从那以后，白冬一直在为他的家族效力：帝国的粮食到不了的地方，什么也长不出来。
OPENING_CHRONICLE_PAGE_4.text_en:
Town by town, the map was filled. The man crowned himself Emperor.
And the White Winter has served his house ever since: where the Empire's grain does not go, nothing grows.
OPENING_CHRONICLE_PAGE_4.direction: Conservative environmental bed only; never add unsupported literal events from historical nouns.

OPENING_CHRONICLE_PAGE_5.text_zh:
如今，在那张地图参差的边缘，一个人正在逃命，身后是四十个骑手和他们的猎狗。
他找到了一条线索，指向帝国唯一不能容许的东西：对抗白冬的方法。
OPENING_CHRONICLE_PAGE_5.text_en:
Now, at the ragged edge of that map, a man runs for his life, with forty riders and their dogs behind him.
He has found a clue to the one thing the Empire cannot allow: a way to stand against the White Winter.
OPENING_CHRONICLE_PAGE_5.direction: Conservative environmental bed only; never add unsupported literal events from historical nouns.
